'''''Aira elegans''''' is a species of plant in the family [[Poaceae]].<ref name=POWO/> It is commonly known as '''Mediterranean hairgrass''', '''elegant hairgrass''' and the '''annual silver hairgrass'''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=''Aira elegans'' - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/51596586|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=''Aira elegans'' (Mediterranean Hairgrass) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/POAC/Aira_elegans.php|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref> It is native to Europe, North Africa, Western Asia and the Caucasus.<ref name=POWO/>
